author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Why open source tools is better than closed source commercial tools?

You can fix the bug yourself with the help of Claude, file a PR, and the bug is merged into main within the same day thanks to Claude/GPT

In comparison, you file a ticket against the tool vendor, you wait a few days for the first response, they ask you to try a few things, you did and wait a few more days, finally their R&D agree it is a bug. You will be lucky if you see the fix next quarter, next year is the norm, if your bug is not important, they may not bother to fix it, just ask you to workaround it
